How ordering works

No card details are stored anywhere — you order online, then confirm payment directly with our team.

1

Add items to your order

Browse the collection, choose colour/size and quantity, and add each item to your order bag.

2

Enter delivery details

Tell us your name, phone number and delivery address so we know where your items are headed.

3

Pay by bank transfer

You'll get our account details and a unique order reference to use as your payment narration.

4

Confirm & relax

Send your payment proof via WhatsApp or email — we'll confirm your order and arrange delivery.
